Food "Fresh and Delicious Tuna Directly Shipped from 'Yama Ko' at Affordable Prices"

Our pride is offering fresh, high-quality sushi at an affordable price. We work directly with fishermen to receive freshly caught ingredients delivered straight to us. By starting our own wholesale operations, we've managed to keep our procurement costs down, achieving outstanding cost performance. We especially recommend the tuna sourced from "Yamakou," which we secured at the Toyosu auction. Enjoy the exceptional freshness and quality of our carefully selected tuna to the fullest!

Space"Relax Without Tension: A Spacious Environment That Changes the Traditional Image of Sushi Restaurants"

Reinventing the traditional image of sushi restaurants, which can often feel "stuffy" or "intimidating," 【Isshiki Sancho】 offers a place where you can enjoy high-quality sushi in a casual setting. In our open and inviting atmosphere, you can relax and have a pleasant time without any pretense. Our friendly and approachable staff will welcome you, so please feel free to visit us. We also recommend our restaurant for special occasions such as business meals, anniversary dates, and celebrations on significant days.

Drink"Perfect Pairing with Sushi: Selections Curated by Sake Experts"

We offer a perfect pairing of premium sushi and Japanese sake. Our skilled sushi chefs, well-versed in sake, carefully select the best brands for you. Enjoy seasonal sake that changes with the market, paired with our meticulously crafted sushi. In addition to sake, our drink menu features selections curated by sommeliers and sake experts. All drinks are served with crushed ice, allowing you to savor your favorite drink alongside our sushi.

Chef"Skilled Techniques and Comfortable Hospitality: Many Craftsmen from Renowned Establishments"

Our restaurant is proud to have many skilled artisans from Michelin-rated establishments. We also have experts in Japanese sake who can suggest perfect pairings to enhance your sushi experience. Our friendly and approachable staff is here to welcome you, so feel free to reach out anytime. Enjoy a relaxing time with top-notch skills and warm hospitality, all without any pressure.

Food "Yakiniku and Japanese-Western-Chinese Buffet Featuring Over 150 Dishes Including King Crab"

A large-scale buffet featuring a rich lineup of dishes, including grilled meat, Japanese, Western, and Chinese cuisine. You can slowly savor your favorite cuts of grilled meat cooked to your liking. In addition, you can enjoy approximately 30 types of sushi crafted by a former sushi chef, as well as luxurious items such as domestically sourced king crab and snow crab, authentic Peking duck, and shrimp chili prepared by Chinese chefs. There are also desserts like cakes and ice cream, so please enjoy a blissful time that satisfies both your body and soul until the very end.

Space"All 400 Seats ◆ A Serene Time in an Elegant Space Suitable for Special Days"

The elegantly designed interior of the restaurant cherishes the beautiful essence of Japanese aesthetics. The wooden tables and black sofa seating create a chic and sophisticated atmosphere. With an unprecedentedly large buffet, you can enjoy a relaxed time within the restaurant. We also have private rooms available, making it perfect for special occasions with loved ones, such as anniversaries, celebrations, dates, girls' nights out, and business meetings. Please enjoy a graceful moment in our spacious and comfortable environment, which accommodates 400 seats.

Food "Enjoy Hokkaido Crab at a Reasonable Price!"

Enjoy 120 minutes of all-you-can-eat King and Snow Crab, freshly delivered from Hokkaido! We carefully select large, meaty Snow Crabs that are sure to satisfy your appetite. Our goal is to let you enjoy the luxurious taste of crab at an affordable price, which is why we offer this all-you-can-eat experience for just JPY 13,000. Dive into a crab feast with our Snow Crab and sushi buffet!

Food "Exquisite Sushi Delivered by a Sushi Chef in a Live Kitchen"

Edo-style sushi crafted by highly skilled artisans who have honed their skills. Enjoy the "freshly made taste" delivered from our live kitchen at the counter! In addition to the classic offerings like "bluefin tuna," "winter yellowtail with caviar," "salmon," and "braised eel," we also have a selection of seasonal fish carefully chosen by our discerning experts. Additionally, you can enjoy over 30 varieties of seafood, including box sushi, hand rolls, sashimi, and grilled seafood. Experience the "ultimate sushi" that delights the eyes, the palate, and all five senses.

閉じる

Food "The Gentle Rice of Red Vinegar and the Sincere Craftsmanship of Edomae: Savoring the Supreme Sushi Piece"

The dish is finished with a mild red vinegar that has a rounded flavor, enhancing the individuality of the ingredients and harmonizing them in your mouth. Enjoy the exquisite balance of the gentle texture that melts in your mouth and the harmony of the ingredients.

Space"Enjoying Warm Hospitality in a Richly Expressive and Serene Space"

Passing through the noren curtain, I make my way down a corridor illuminated by soft lighting. The elegant white wooden counter stretches out gracefully, with only eight seats available. In the pleasant tension that makes one sit up straight, the warm hospitality of the owner gently loosens the strings of the guests' hearts.

Food "An Encounter with a Grip that Surpasses Imagination, Born from Elegant Movements"

Artistic creations of exquisite hand-formed sushi, born from techniques that leave no room for waste. The commitment to the ingredients is unwavering, and there is no compromise when it comes to the rice. The rice, shaped with a perfect balance of pressure, gently dissolves in the mouth, leaving behind a sensual sweetness. The temperature of the rice is adjusted daily to match the varying conditions of the ingredients.

Space"Private Rooms Available - Perfect for Face-to-Face Meetings and Entertaining Guests"

In addition to counter seats, we also have private rooms, making it ideal for face-to-face meetings and important business entertaining.

Food "Seasonal Ingredients at Their Best"

We carefully select seasonal ingredients and prepare them to be served at their most delicious state. Please enjoy the chef's proud creations, honed at a Michelin-listed restaurant.

Space"Private Rooms Available: A Space That Reflects the Owner's Personality"

We offer a wide variety of seating and plans for both lunch and dinner to suit your budget and occasion. Whether it's for a company reception, a celebratory meal, or special events such as weddings and funerals, our options are perfect for a special day’s dining experience.

Food "Sushi and Tempura that Pair Well with Sake"

We have captured the "best moment" of the ingredients and wrapped their original deliciousness and charm in a coating. The moment it enters your mouth, you will experience an explosion of umami and a lingering quiet aftertaste... Please enjoy this tempura that allows you to savor the natural story delivered by the "season."

Food "High-Quality Counter Seats: Experience the Atmosphere of Japanese Cuisine and the Chef's Hospitality."

We have 10 beautiful hinoki wood counter seats available. Enjoy the unique experience that only counter seating can offer, where you can savor the chef's knife skills and the rising aromas while indulging in your meal without any reservations.
